name: Busa Sales Outreach
description: Product positioning, ideal-customer profile, target accounts, contacts, and reviewed outreach

agentPrompts.label: What's my next step on the desk?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder, then open the desk and report the current bounded next step — how many accounts are to-send, sent, and opted-out.

agentPrompts.label: Find new target accounts
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder and follow its `research` subcommand, then run one bounded round (20-30 accounts) to find companies with observable pain/buying signals against my ICP, identify one public contact per company, and draft a personalized first-touch email grounded in that evidence for each — never guess an email address or overwrite an existing company row.

agentPrompts.label: Send my approved first touches
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder and follow its `send` subcommand, then send only the individually approved, `queued` first-touch emails — re-check each account's status immediately before sending and skip anything already sent or opted-out. One company gets one initial email.
